title: Settings
signIn: Sign in to change your account settings

issue.endpoint: Enter a full address, such as http://127.0.0.1:6800/jsonrpc

site.languageHint: Also used for the emails sent to you.
site.contentLimitHint: How games and images with adult content are shown.

1.label: Hide
1.description: Games and images with adult content are not shown.

2.label: Mask
2.description: Games are shown; images stay covered until you click them.

3.label: Show
3.description: Everything is shown as it is.

site.onlyWithResourcesHint: The default for the library and search; you can change it for a single visit there.

download.local: Download settings are saved in this browser only and do not follow your account.

browser.label: Browser
browser.description: The browser downloads the file itself.

aria2.label: Send to aria2
aria2.description: Sends the download to an aria2 on this computer or your local network.

download.aria2Hint: Enable RPC in aria2 first and allow cross-origin requests from this site.
download.secretHint: Leave empty when no secret is set.
download.directoryHint: Optional; aria2's default directory is used when empty.

unreachable.unreachable: Could not reach aria2. Check the address, and that aria2 is running and allows cross-origin requests.
unreachable.unauthorized: aria2 rejected the secret. Check the RPC secret.

personal.avatarHint: Shown as a circle; a square image works best.
personal.coverHint: Shown at the top of your profile; a wide image works best.
personal.name: User name
personal.nameHint: Used to sign in, and shown beside what you upload and write.
